notes.title: We need your opinions!
notes.content:
We've recieved some feedback considering the "golden circle" achievement. Some of you want the achievement not to be limited, so that everyone can 100% the game, including if they only have the standard version. 

Please take the time to awnser this poll so we know what our community wants!

http://www.strawpoll.me/15710753

Also, we are working on making more minigames and achievements, so this achievement wont be the only one to 100%! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Minitime Limited Edition achievement issue fix
notes.content:
Hi all

We just pushed an update which should fix the achievement issue. You should recieve it as intended now.

please contact us if you're still having issues!

notes.title: Limited edition Achievement issues
notes.content: We are aware that some of you aren't getting the "golden circle" achievement which is a part of the limited edition. we are working to fix the issue.
